Data-Driven Betting Insights

Scottie Scheffler presents exceptional value at +845 with the model giving him a massive 10.6% win probability despite negative course fit, backed by elite +2.64 SG Total ranking #1 in the field. Collin Morikawa (+2209) stands out with the best iron play in the field (+0.96 SG Approach) and positive +0.182 course fit, while the longshot tier offers compelling options led by Hideki Matsuyama at +5248 with solid +1.32 SG Total and strong 17.6% top-10 probability. The model identifies significant betting edges across multiple price points, with several players offering 2-4% win probability advantages over their implied odds.
